allocation: Original whole limits intersect original cell/action/phase limits and full standalone setup charge. No new numeric limit is supplied by this policy.
comparison_rule: All32 contrast rows remain; numerical-only effects may persist with typed qualifications; qualified joint family unavailable if any required numerical/semantic/resource dependency is unavailable.
historical_rule: Fresh exact source/policy/profile/campaign required before exposure; no old-campaign relabeling, backfill or reinterpretation.
interpretation: Compared under the same prospectively selected measured resource envelopes; native cumulative logical I/O and native file churn were not measured.

cpu_seconds.scope: Original controller process CPU plus original waited host/control/service child CPU plus enclosing actor/holder/provider cgroup CPU once. Provider subintervals are not summed again. Whole selected runtime coverage/enforcement remains independently qualified.

files.scope: Source-owned Budget.admit_write call before regular-file creation; acknowledged creations separately recorded. This is not native file churn or directory/kernel/daemon operations.

memory_and_storage.scope: Original native cgroup memory peak/caps, per-resource live scratch/output/request/inode caps, retained managed extents/reservations. Actor cgroup memory is only a component; whole selected host/daemon/capture/publication bound requires independent runtime qualification.

model_calls_and_tokens.scope: Existing broker global/cell token ledger and actual attempted investigator dispatch, including failures; unknown use retains original reservation and blocks dependent execution.
model_calls_and_tokens.unit: actual attempted calls and original token counts/reservations

adapters: postscore ordinary mailbox and independently qualified external managed transfer snapshot
read_bytes.scope: Source-owned capture/read/copy/kernel-control adapters; not all interpreter/library/daemon/kernel I/O.

stream_bytes.scope: Original ProcessRunner control/provider/capture stdout/stderr. A later journal write is a separate operation; these views are not summed as unique physical bytes.

wall_seconds.scope: One original campaign origin through imports/source/setup/actors/control/transport/scoring/reporting/publication/failure; nested deadlines intersect, never restart.

write_bytes.scope: Source-owned Journal/Views/FeatureStream/cgroup writes and independently qualified external managed transfers, including failure/publication work. Native tmpfs capacity is never a write debit.

overlap: Physical unique operations and full standalone attribution are separate, nonadditive views; managed transfer/stream/copy repetitions are real distinct operations, not deduplicated logical payloads.
required_unknowns: Every unavailable required managed transfer, CPU/wall/memory, provider dispatch/token, completion/custody/closure or setup quantity remains blocking. Only the exact three named native I/O/churn exclusions do not alone veto remaining-envelope/scorer admission.
reservations: Journal completion bytes/files reserve existing write/live/file headroom; native capacity reserves live bytes/inodes separately, never cumulative native writes. No sound bound is inferred for an unobserved native total.
setup_rule: Full original R2 standalone measured setup plus own calls for every consumer; unique physical setup once; native setup I/O unknown in both views, never free missing measured setup.
source_provenance: Public prospective measured-envelope definition; historical private selection/evidence ledgers are not distributed. Runtime admission still requires independently supplied current evidence.
status: root-selected prospective definition; source/native/scientific qualification separate
target_rule: Complete original 960-terminal/96-panel/1920-phase barrier, source/input/state/custody/closure and remaining scorer envelope still precede targets.
